rules.requiredEvidence: Independent reviewed destination-account evidence of existing App Runner eligibility. None of the frozen new-client evaluation briefs supplies that evidence. Labels or a model assertion are insufficient.
rules.replacementGuidance: For a small synchronous public FAQ, prefer the qualified Lambda/HTTP API v2 source contract. For general container workloads, evaluate ECS/ECS Express Mode and its actual permissions/network/costs. Preserve existing systems instead of migrating them without approval.
